beats.speaker: me
beats.text: I'll start my project... right after this.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: You've said that for three weeks.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Start for five minutes. Starting is the hard part.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Only five? I can do five.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Not 'write the report.' Just 'write the title.'

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip three: put your phone in another room.
beats.title: 3. Phone out of reach

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Another room? Like... a different room?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Wait. I just finished the whole thing!

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Amazing what happens when you start.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Send this to your procrastinating friend.
